trust_score_explanation: Reliable newspaper with professional editorial standards, but still requires article-level verification.
Established public broadcaster with strong editorial standards and independent fact-checking processes.
International news agency known for rigorous sourcing and neutral, wire-service style reporting.
Major French newspaper of record with professional editorial standards and a dedicated fact-checking unit.
Crowd-edited encyclopedia; generally reliable for established facts but should be cross-checked on contested or recent topics.
Dedicated fact-checking organization; methodology is generally transparent though occasionally contested.
Partisan outlet with a documented history of misleading headlines; claims require independent cross-verification.
State-funded outlet flagged by multiple media literacy and disinformation research organizations for selective framing.
Satirical publication; content is intentionally fictional and should never be treated as factual reporting.
Open self-publishing platform; reliability varies widely by individual author since there is no shared editorial oversight.
